svg.metadata: {"id": "s037", "name": "尺规作图桌", "cat": "数学", "tags": ["数学", "几何", "尺规作图", "图形"], "desc": "几何作图角：画板上用圆规交弧作出等边三角形、圆内接正六边形，桌上有大圆规、直尺、量角器和台灯。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [600, 1320]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "window", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "easel", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "board", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "construction", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "compass_on_board", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "swing", "depth": null}, {"name": "desk_left", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "big_compass", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.65, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "desk_right", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lamp_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "shelf", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "plant", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.8, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#ECEFF8", "wall2": "#DADFF0", "grid": "#D3D9EC", "board": "#FFFFFF", "bgrid": "#E3EAF5", "frame": "#8D6A9F", "frame2": "#6F5082", "ink": "#2E3A59", "arc": "#5FA8E0", "tri": "#F27C66", "hex": "#6CC59A", "desk": "#E7B98A", "desk2": "#C9925E", "wood": "#B57A4A", "wood2": "#8A5833", "metal": "#9AA6B2", "metal2": "#6C7884", "lamp": "#FFE3A3", "lampb": "#F2C14E", "ruler": "#FFE7A8", "rtick": "#3D4B5C", "floor1": "#C9B8D6", "floor2": "#B19EC2", "book1": "#F27C66", "book2": "#5FA8E0", "book3": "#F7C44E", "book4": "#6CC59A", "leaf": "#6DB585", "leaf2": "#A6D99A", "win1": "#A6DCF7", "win2": "#E8F7FF"}}
